title: limonium vulgare subsp. bahusiense
intro: Limonium vulgare subsp. bahusiense, commonly known as Statice, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and soothing skin irritations, making it beneficial for overall health. The bioactive constituents of Statice include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fight infections, may be attributed to the presence of these bioactive compounds, which have been used to treat various health conditions.
